parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The database engine of the instance. Valid values:

mysql: MySQL
mssql: SQL Server
PostgreSQL: PostgreSQL
MariaDB: MariaDB
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，取值：
mysql：MySQL数据库
mssql：SQL Server数据库
PostgreSQL：PostgreSQL数据库
MariaDB：MariaDB数据库
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The version of the database engine. Valid values:

Valid values when you set the Engine parameter to mysql: 5.5, 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0.
Valid values when you set the Engine parameter to mssql: 2008r2.
Valid values when you set the Engine parameter to PostgreSQL: 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, and 15.0.
Valid values when you set the Engine parameter to MariaDB: 10.3
parameters.help_zh:
数据库版本号，取值：
MySQL数据库：5.5、5.6、5.7、8.0
SQL Server数据库：2008r2
PostgreSQL数据库：10.0、11.0、12.0、13.0、14.0、15.0
MariaDB数据库：10.3
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The RDS edition of the instance. Valid values:

Basic: RDS Basic Edition
HighAvailability: RDS High-availability Edition
Finance: RDS Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列，取值：

Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
Finance：三节点企业系列
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
